_about: Phase 2: boats and the river trade. The Apalachicola is the one road the Rogues don't own. Times in ms, distances in metres, speeds in m/s.

jonboat.name: Jon boat
jonboat._about: Flat-bottomed workhorse: slow, sturdy, room for three and a big hold.

airboat.name: Airboat
airboat._about: Fast but loud: everyone within 2,000 ft sees it on their minimap. Small hold.

rules._about: minDepth: how deep the water must be to float a boat. Boats left unattended can be hotwired by anyone (hotwireMs); your crew just gets in. Shots hit boats; a sunk boat drops its hold on the nearest bank.

docks._about: A landing on the river bank for each river town (within maxFromTown of the river) and each swamp camp. Buy, repair and launch boats here; river freight runs between landings.

camps._about: River-people camps in the swamp, away from roads and towns: a landing, a few claimable shacks and a camp trader. No fighting inside safeRadius.

trader._about: sellsCheap: what the camp produces, at price per unit; stockPerHour: how much of each it has to sell (it restocks that much an hour and holds one hour's worth, shared by everyone). pays: what the camp pays for what it can't make (multiple of the base price). Camps don't buy cooked meals: they sell the fish.

freight._about: River freight: bulk cargo that only fits in a boat's hold (one slot each). Pays more than foot freight. pay = base + km * perKm.
